technical.summary: Bullish structure with price above all key MAs and positive volume signals, but weak trend strength (ADX 15.4), overbought conditions (Williams %R), and negative MACD histogram limit conviction for a high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: DTE shows no fundamental momentum with zero insider activity, no institutional signal, absent government contracts, no lobbying presence, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 14 days adds execution risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (35/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but absent congressional conviction and no recent news data limit conviction.

risk.summary: Crisis VIX (391.84) and FOMC event just passed create severe near-term volatility; utilities defensive but earnings binary in 14 days compounds risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major MAs with bullish volume signals (OBV, Force Index) and contrarian buy opportunity in extreme fear zone (VIX crisis) offers technical setup for mean reversion.
debate.key_bear_argument: Weak trend strength (ADX 15.38), overbought conditions (Williams %R), negative MACD histogram, zero fundamental support, earnings binary risk in 14 days, and crisis macro environment (VIX 391.84, post-FOMC volatility) create asymmetric downside risk.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical structure is bullish (price above MAs, positive volume) and contrarian opportunity exists in extreme fear zone, but conviction is undermined by weak trend strength, overbought conditions, and zero fundamental support.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings binary event in 14 days combined with crisis VIX (391.84) and post-FOMC volatility creates asymmetric downside risk that outweighs technical setup quality.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding 40 positions in Utilities sector with existing DTE position; concentration risk and sector saturation reduce conviction further and argue against new entry.
